chunks: And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"It is not permissible for a ruler who believes in Allah and the Last Day to administer more than ten lashes except in the case of a legal punishment (hadd)."

key_terms.الْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ: the Last Day, which grounds moral accountability
key_terms.فِي حَدٍّ: within a hadd punishment, a fixed legal penalty

ai.seo_question: When can a ruler administer more than ten lashes in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith sets a legal limit on discretionary corporal punishment, restricting it to no more than ten lashes unless the case falls under an established hadd punishment. It emphasizes accountable governance and ties judicial conduct to faith in Allah and the Last Day.
